requirements.description: Preserve FIFO head instruction across flush_cnt_q > 0, suppress same-cycle wrong-path FIFO push on hwlp_jump_i && !fifo_empty_i, clear stale delayed flush on hwlp_flush_resp, update trans_addr_o on hwlp_jump_i in BRANCH_WAIT, and count only non-flushed outstanding requests (cnt_q - flush_cnt_q) in FIFO capacity check.

Update pc_n and next_state (ALIGNED32 vs BRANCH_MISALIGNED based on target[1]) across all instruction-advancing states (ALIGNED32 32b/16b, MISALIGNED32 32b/16b, MISALIGNED16 32b/16b, BRANCH_MISALIGNED 16b) when hwlp_update_pc_i || hwlp_update_pc_q.

Propagate OBI instruction errors through prefetch_buffer/fifo to aligner and if_stage, freeze speculative requests after a non-flushed error until branch_i/hwlp_jump_i, attribute errors to the exact instruction across spanning/compressed states, transition aligner to WAIT_VALID_BRANCH on error, and mask illegal_c_insn_id_o on fetch_failed.
requirements.verified_by: tb.sv Phase 5A, Phase 5B, Phase 5C, Phase 5D, Phase 6
